boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Connecticut
boards.description: Ten currently documented UConn destinations with evening availability, centered on campus dining and the Student Union.

cards.title: Northwest Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Storrs campus • late-night dining Sunday–Thursday
cards.notes: Use the published late-night schedule before heading over; Northwest is listed until 10pm Sunday through Thursday during fall and spring semesters.
cards.short_summary: A residential dining hall with documented 10pm late-night service on most weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Northwest Dining Hall as open until 10pm Sunday through Thursday for Fall 2025 and Spring 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published Fall 2025/Spring 2026 hours: until 10pm Sunday–Thursday; hours may change during breaks, weather, or building changes.

cards.title: South Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Storrs campus • late-night dining Sunday–Thursday
cards.notes: Check the late-night schedule on the day you go; South is listed until 10pm Sunday through Thursday during fall and spring semesters.
cards.short_summary: A second campus dining-hall option with documented late service on most weeknights.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists South Dining Hall as open until 10pm Sunday through Thursday for Fall 2025 and Spring 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published Fall 2025/Spring 2026 hours: until 10pm Sunday–Thursday; hours may change during breaks, weather, or building changes.

cards.title: Putnam Grab & Go
cards.subtitle: Putnam residence-hall area • evening pickup
cards.notes: Plan for an evening stop rather than a full dining-hall visit; the listed semester schedule runs 4pm–10pm Monday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A named Grab & Go location with evening semester hours near Putnam.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Putnam Grab & Go open 4pm–10pm Monday through Thursday during Fall 2025 and Spring 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 4–10pm Monday–Thursday, 4–8pm Friday; closed Saturday and Sunday. Located near the Putnam dining-hall entrance.

cards.title: Gelfenbien Grab & Go
cards.subtitle: Gelfenbien residence-hall area • evening pickup
cards.notes: Use the posted evening window for a quick stop; the listed semester schedule runs 4:30pm–10pm Monday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A named Grab & Go location with documented evening hours at Gelfenbien.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Gelfenbien Grab & Go open 4:30pm–10pm Monday through Thursday during Fall 2025 and Spring 2026.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: 4:30–10pm Monday–Thursday, 4:30–8pm Friday; closed Saturday and Sunday. Located at the Gelfenbien building entrance.

cards.title: Union Street Market
cards.subtitle: Student Union lower level • Friday until 11pm
cards.notes: Aim for Friday if you need the latest listed campus retail window; Union Street Market is posted until 11pm, with shorter hours other days.
cards.short_summary: Student Union market with the latest listed retail closing time on Friday.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Union Street Market open until 11pm on Fridays during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: Published semester hours: until 9pm Sunday–Thursday, 11pm Friday, and 10pm Saturday; located in the Student Union lower level.

cards.title: Bookworms Cafe
cards.subtitle: UConn Library main level • open until 11pm
cards.notes: Pair a late coffee or snack with library time; the current semester listing keeps Bookworms open until 11pm Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.short_summary: Library café with published 11pm service Sunday through Wednesday.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Bookworms Cafe open until 11pm Sunday through Wednesday during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: Published semester hours: until 11pm Sunday–Wednesday, 9pm Thursday, and 5pm Friday–Saturday; located on the Library main level.

cards.title: Union Central Exchange C-Store
cards.subtitle: Student Union second floor • weekday evening hours
cards.notes: For a straightforward campus-store stop, use the second-floor Union location; its semester listing stays open until 9:30pm on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A named Student Union convenience store with documented weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists Union Central Exchange C-Store open 9am–9:30pm Monday through Friday during the semester.
cards.source_title: Union Central Exchange C-Store | UConn Dining Services
cards.access_notes: Semester hours are 9am–9:30pm weekdays and noon–9pm weekends. The store is on the Student Union second floor, diagonal from Dunkin'.

cards.entity_name: Dunkin' at the UConn Student Union
cards.title: Dunkin' at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Student Union second floor south • listed until 10pm
cards.notes: Check the Student Union dining page before going; its posted semester schedule lists Dunkin' closing at 10pm every day, with break changes noted.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee-and-food counter with a documented 10pm semester closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Student Union lists Dunkin' open until 10pm Sunday through Saturday, with hours varying during semester breaks.
cards.access_notes: Posted semester hours close at 10pm daily; the page states that hours during semester breaks vary. Listed on the Student Union second floor south.

cards.title: UConn Student Union
cards.subtitle: 2110 Hillside Road • building open until 11:30pm
cards.notes: Use the building as an indoor evening destination and confirm any special closure first; current spring hours list an 11:30pm closing time each day.
cards.short_summary: A named campus hub with published late-evening building access.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Student Union publishes Spring Semester 2026 operating hours ending at 11:30pm Sunday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hours, Location and Parking | UConn Student Union
cards.access_notes: Spring Semester 2026 normal building hours end at 11:30pm daily. Spring-break and special-event closures can modify access.

cards.entity_name: Convenience Store at the UConn Student Union
cards.title: Convenience Store
cards.subtitle: Student Union second floor • open until 9:30pm weekdays
cards.notes: Stop by before the late evening cutoff; UConn lists the Student Union Convenience Store open through 9:30pm Monday through Friday during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Student Union retail stop with published weekday evening availability.
cards.evidence_claim: UConn Dining lists the Student Union Convenience Store open 9am–9:30pm Monday through Friday during fall and spring semesters.
cards.access_notes: Published semester hours: 9am–9:30pm weekdays and noon–9pm weekends. UConn identifies the location as the Student Union second floor.
